## Overview

Aspose.3D for Python provides comprehensive 3D file processing capabilities including loading, saving, converting, and optimizing 3D models in FBX, OBJ, and STL formats.

## Key Features

- Load and save 3D models in multiple formats (FBX, OBJ, STL).
- Convert between supported formats with a single API call.
- Mesh triangulation and normal recalculation utilities.
- Batch processing support for directory-level operations.
